title: A study to investigate outcomes with elecoglipron compared with placebo in adult participants with chronic kidney disease.
official: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-blind, Parallel-group, Placebo-controlled Multicenter Study to Evaluate the Effect of Elecoglipron in Reducing Renal Outcomes and Mortality in Participants with Chronic Kidney Disease (Elevate-CKD)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of elecoglipron as compared to placebo in reducing the risk of the composite of ≥50% sustained decline in eGFR, ESKD, or all-cause mortality.
conditions: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) in adults, with specified ranges of eGFR and albuminuria (UACR), irrespective of T2DM status; background SGLT2i dapagliflozin 10 mg as GDMT.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participant must be of the legal age of consent and at least 18 years of age, at the time of signing the informed consent.
2. Confirmed CKD meeting one of the following: - UACR ≥30 to ≤200 mg/g and eGFR ≥20 to <45 mL/min/1.73 m², or - UACR >200 mg/g and eGFR ≥20 to <60 mL/min/1.73 m², or - UACR >500 mg/g and eGFR ≥60 to <90 mL/min/1.73 m².
3. On stable, patient maximum tolerated, labeled daily dose of ACEI or ARB for at least 28 days before screening. Exceptions allowed for patients unable to tolerate RAASi therapy.
4. Male and/or female assigned at birth, inclusive of all gender identities. Definitions for women of childbearing potential and females of nonchildbearing potential, and contraception recommendations for females and males, per CSP Appendix F.
5. Capable of providing signed informed consent per CSP Appendix A, agreeing to comply with ICF and protocol requirements and restrictions.
6. Signed and dated ICF obtained prior to any mandatory study specific procedures, sampling, or analyses.
7. If opting in, signed and dated Optional Genomics Initiative Research Information and Consent Form obtained prior to collection of genomics samples.
Exclusion criteria:
1. BMI <23 kg/m² at screening
2. History/family history (first degree) of medullary thyroid cancer or MEN2
3. History of type 1 diabetes mellitus
4. HbA1c ≥10% (86 mmol/mol) at screening
5. Currently receiving, or anticipated to receive, therapeutic intervention for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema.
6. Have had more than one episode of severe hypoglycemia within 180 days prior to screening, or hypoglycemia unawareness
7. Clinical diagnosis of nephrotic syndrome or active glomerulonephritis
8. Acute coronary syndrome, major cardiac procedure, stroke, or TIA within 3 months prior to screening
9. Clinically significant condition affecting the upper GI tract or chronic use of any medication that affects gastric motility or gastric emptying
10. History of acute or chronic pancreatitis
